Broken razor in food / poor handling of situation
Jun 2024 • Friends
We arrived at 5:00pm and were welcomed emphatically. As we were being seated, a large man wearing an A’s shirt demanded if we had a reservation. Keep in the mind the place had just opened, there was a large reservation screen on the wall with names, and the earliest one was for 5:30. Nothing else was said and we were led to our seats. 

Initially everything was great. Service was prompt in ordering and we had just started into the meal when a working came over to scrape the cooking surface. They use a stick with a razor blade (not the bakery scraper tool, which was also present). In his forcefulness he broke off the metal into the food. I looked down and noticed a large chunk of razor and smaller fragments and alerted him. He seemed unfazed. I got the attention of another server there and she realized it was an issue. Our food now had metal shards in it. 

The ladies there (wish I had there names) were apologetic and moved us immediately to another table. Uncooked food was brought over. The owner in the A’s shirt was brief by his staff and didn’t even come to say sorry. We were then left without food for a while. Items weren’t being cooked (they never gave us the tongs or scissors). And we had to ask several times for attention. 

The food is alright. The Korean owner in the A’s shirt really needs to put a general manager there for situations. He refused to say anything. Avoided looking at us. He really isn’t meant to be in the food and beverage industry. 

Just be aware when you come. It’s not anything you’d miss out on if you went somewhere else.

NEVER COME BACK
Mar 2024 • Family
Firstly, I won't comment on the food as everyone has different tastes, but the issue with the staff's attitude was extremely poor.

I dined at table number 16 at 20:45 (please check the cameras). While my family was eating, a female staff member walked past our table, then used our drinking water pitcher and poured it into the ashtray of another table. The problem here is that we were still using the drinking water pitcher, and there was no permission asked whatsoever. It was extremely disgusting.

When the kimchi fried rice was served, there was no staff member around to serve it. My family had to wait for a long time and lost patience before we had to call another staff member to help fry the rice. However, it took quite a while before someone came to serve us.

WITH SUCH UNPROFESSIONAL SERVICE ATTITUDE AND LACK OF HYGIENE LIKE THIS, I WILL NEVER COME BACK. THERE ARE PLENTY OF BETTER OPTIONS AVAILABLE AT THE SAME PRICE.
